summary: The PR addresses the issue of `DataArray.quantile` not honoring `keep_attrs` by passing the argument through to the `Variable.quantile` method. The changes are minimal and consistent with the project conventions.

issues.description: The addition of two nearly identical scripts (`reproduce.py` and `reproduce_issue.py`) seems redundant. One could suffice.
The `quantile` method in `Variable` could benefit from an updated docstring to reflect the new `keep_attrs` parameter.
